notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes. I tried twice to get to the sources, and neither attempt read a single page:

1. **Opening pages directly didn't work.** I tried six pages: Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub, NET Bible notes and Precept Austin. All six were refused because the tool will only open a page after a search has returned it.
2. **The search was never run.** I tried eight searches, including Job 13 commentaries, the "Though He slay me" debate in v. 15 and "worthless physicians" in v. 4. The tool said I had used up my research calls for this turn before any of them ran.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't written anything from memory. That includes points I'd normally expect to come up, like the Hebrew wording debate in v. 15 or how Gill and Ellicott read v. 4. They would be unsourced and could misrepresent what these teachers say.

If you send the request again, I'll search first and then open the pages it returns. The main ones would be the Job 13 pages on Enduring Word, biblehub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit), Precept Austin and NET Bible. Next would come pages on the debate over v. 15 and anything tradition-specific (Spurgeon, Wesley's notes, Lutheran, Catholic or Orthodox). Then I'll write the verse-by-verse notes with a URL for every point. Or, if you have particular pages or quotes you want used, paste them in and I'll work from those.
